items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: S2 scope covered: one assembling reader, per-file status, recovery, newest-by-ts position readers, KC8 primitive, KC1 renders, ratchet tightened.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: OSError per file becomes status unreadable; finalized_run_ids still returns None on unreadable; unparseable ts sorts first, ties keep position.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Symlinked and non-jsonl files are never read; drop key is parsed from the file name and matched exactly, never used to build a path.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Order, status, recovery, duplicate rule, KC8 exact-key/tolerance, position readers, KC1 byte-identical renders with non-vacuity check.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One read per file; no folders means one read as before. Sort only on archive and drop records.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New module events_read.py; events_log stays under 300 lines; handoff and dashboard files not above their bloat baseline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Jsonl drop files round-trip through the reader; unsplit/split fixture pair compared; ADR-045 load contexts tests pass.
